scope: Seven related analyst observations; one newly read two-page reproduced operator interview plus clearly marked earlier context, not seven independent witnesses.

observations.kind: Reported original screen print and intended engineering handoff
observations.source_report: A computer-screen print containing administrative call information reportedly was made when the call disconnected, with information to be passed to engineering to determine where the call was made on the aircraft.
observations.distinction: Reported creation and intended destination are different from actual transfer, receipt, completed engineering analysis or a location determination. The print and result are not attached to these pages.
observations.missing_discriminator: Actual screen print with field/layout/session identity; dispatch/receipt and engineering work order, analysis, result and retained attachments. Match to separately reported agent handoffs by artifact/content/date/custody, not generic print-screen wording.

observations.distinction: The reference identifies an interview to locate. It does not establish that the held September 2001 or May 2004 supervisor representations are this serial or that every attachment is present.
observations.missing_discriminator: Actual serial 3255 with cover/continuations/enclosures, native release/version and interview/notes/custody association.

observations.kind: Initial operator time and hold phases versus supervisor account

pins.passage: First substantive paragraph: As a part of her normal duties

source_values.initial_operator_total: less than ten minutes, speaking or conferring with supervisor

comparison.comparison_scope: Previously read context, re-viewed this unit; different operator/phase roles, no native event match.

observations.distinction: Estimates are not calibrated starts or billed duration. Initial receipt and supervisor participation may denote different events, but no event join or cause is established. Do not sum estimates into an exact hold interval or repair either time.
observations.missing_discriminator: Native agent/session/conference/hold event records, field/clock definitions and source interview notes; original first-operator/supervisor handoff mapping.

pins.passage: Final paragraph: JOHNSON returned; as JOHNSON recalls

source_values.screen_information_scope: First substantive paragraph reports only that the screen indicated a United Airlines flight.

comparison.proposed_comparison_basis: Both accounts name the caller Beamer, United and San Francisco and describe supervisor participation; a proposed documentary association, not a native session/voice/serial match.

observations.distinction: Preserve 99 and 93 with their attribution/qualification. The source does not say the screen displayed 99. No preferred actual spoken number, aircraft identification, different call or fabrication follows from the two reports.
observations.missing_discriminator: Original call/media/notes and screen record with identifier definitions, independent session/caller/source-to-exhibit joins.

observations.distinction: The page introduces and repeatedly uses JOHNSON, but uses JACKSON in two consultation sentences without explanation. No alias, second staff member, preferred surname or cause is selected; this does not establish a fabricated or altered record.
observations.missing_discriminator: Original interview notes/audio and report draft/correction/version records; no recovery of masked identities or personal profile.

observations.kind: Reported words versus inference and nonrecollection
observations.source_report: The report distinguishes the caller describing two people with knives and someone entering the cockpit from the operator concluding the latter was additional. It reports unusual quiet/calm and explicitly says she did not recall clothing or ethnicity descriptions.
observations.distinction: An operator inference is not a direct count of three observed attackers. Quiet/calm is a reported perception, not an acoustic test. Failure to recall a description is not proof no description occurred; none authenticates or disproves a caller.
observations.missing_discriminator: Source-native notes/media and exact source-generation/role/phase mapping, with direct speech, inference and nonrecollection retained separately.

comparison.prior_verified_context: May 11, 2004 memorandum records uncertainty about whether the first operator Johnson took notes.

observations.distinction: The June 2002 interview identifies a computer print, not a declaration that the operator made handwritten notes. It neither contradicts nor resolves the 2004 uncertainty. No claim that notes or recording were found.
observations.missing_discriminator: Individual original notes, print, contemporaneous report/letter/enclosures, custody receipt and actual interview source versions. Preserve distinct artifacts without merging them.
